ITEM 1 | Leafy greens, mostly dark green and light green lettuce leaves with ruffled edges, spread across the bowl's lower-left and upper-left, some leaves torn and wilted at the edges, slightly moist sheen | 110
ITEM 2 | Cubes of pale cream-to-golden meat or cheese-like pieces, roughly 1.5 to 2 cm, with browned crusty edges on some cubes, scattered over the greens and upper right | 95
ITEM 3 | Dark purple-black olive halves and whole olives, about 1 to 2 cm, glossy skin, some partly coated in dressing, clustered across the center and right side | 35
ITEM 4 | Creamy pale off-white dressing, thick and opaque with a slightly glossy sheen, drizzled and pooled over the center of the greens, flowing in streaks and clumps | 60
ITEM 5 | Small pale yellow-white cubes or chunks, about 1 cm, firm and dry-looking, scattered among the greens near the top center | 15
ITEM 6 | Thin pale green strips and slivers, slightly translucent, lying among the leaves at the upper center | 8
